NutriBaby Foods, a commercial baby food manufacturing plant, produces premium instant infant cereals and dehydrated fruit powders. For heat-sensitive strawberry and banana purees, however, thermal drum drying is rejected because high heat destroys vitamin C, beta-carotene, and delicate natural aromatic flavor compounds.
